summary: Reproduced the GLM-4 and GLM-4.7 streaming mismatch on the prepared base, then applied the shared unknown-tool policy when each streaming name becomes complete. Disabled unknown calls are consumed without deltas or a tool index, including when a declared call follows in the same chunk; enabled forwarding remains unchanged.

tests.what_was_measured: Before the fix, both detectors emitted [(0, 'unknown', ''), (0, None, '{}')] while one-shot parsing emitted no calls; raw output is reports/j-40a3bdc36526/raw/baseline_reproduction.txt.
36 CPU parser tests passed, including both GLM detectors, both forwarding policy values, character-at-a-time recovery, and same-chunk recovery to a following declared call.
Formatting tool availability only: the prepared interpreter does not contain the black module. git diff --check passed separately.

gpu_execution_evidence: The defect and fix are deterministic CPU-only text parser state transitions; no model execution, numerical kernel, or GPU behavior is involved.
remaining_limitations: No model-serving reproduction was performed because parser-level character streaming reproduces the reported defect without weights and directly exercises the affected implementation.
The prepared interpreter lacks black and ruff; git diff --check passed, but those formatter/linter executables could not be run.
Upstream PR https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/34090 independently contains the same policy/state approach but remains open; the prepared base did not contain that fix.
